headline: Ceasefire toll stands at 1,602 killed / 5,794 wounded since Oct 11, 2025
dek: [VERIFIED FACT -- Al Jazeera, Nov 5, 17:04 ] Israeli attacks killed at least four Palestinians on Thursday, including a child, in central and southern Gaza: Abdul Rahim Walid Matar, 27, killed at dawn when an Israeli drone fired two missiles at a tent sheltering displaced people west of…
sources: Al Jazeera (medical sources at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Nasser Medical Complex, al-Awda Hospital, al-Shifa Hospital); Gaza Health Ministry daily report (Wed Nov 4)
fault_line: Is this still a ceasefire at all - 1,602 killed and 5,989 recorded violations into a truce that was supposed to end the killing, or is the toll the price of a truce Israel says Hamas keeps violating?

sections.what_happened: [VERIFIED FACT -- Al Jazeera, Nov 5, 17:04 ] Israeli attacks killed at least four Palestinians on Thursday, including a child, in central and southern Gaza: Abdul Rahim Walid Matar, 27, killed at dawn when an Israeli drone fired two missiles at a tent sheltering displaced people west of az-Zawayda (medical sources at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital); a woman killed and two wounded by Israeli fire outside Israeli-controlled areas in Khan Younis (Nasser Medical Complex); a child killed by Israeli fire in Bureij refugee camp; another person killed in a drone strike at az-Zawaya. A drone strike on a gathering in al-Baraka, Deir el-Balah, wounded several, one critically; a Palestinian was wounded when a drone struck an apartment in al-Karama, northwest Gaza City; artillery shelled eastern Gaza City and naval vessels fired towards the coastline; forces bulldozed homes and farmland east of al-Musaddar and Deir el-Balah, absorbing more land behind the so-called 'Yellow Line'. [VERIFIED FACT -- Gaza Health Ministry, Wed Nov 4 report, via Al Jazeera/Daily Sabah] 1,602 Palestinians killed and 5,794 wounded since the ceasefire took effect Oct 11, 2025; cumulative toll since Oct 2023: 74,618 killed, 175,920 wounded. Gaza Government Media Office (Monday): 5,989 ceasefire violations since the truce began; 753 in October (346 shootings, 310 bombardments, 64 home demolitions). This updates 1300-05, which reported only the az-Zawayda victim confirmed plus 5 injured: the day's confirmed death count is now four.
sections.what_verified: Three declared families agree on the Thursday deaths and the 1,602 figure: Al Jazeera (T2) + Daily Sabah (T3) + Hurriyet Daily News (T3). Al Mayadeen relayed the same ministry figures but has NO declared tier in the registry, so it is reported with attribution only and does not count. Minor dating discrepancy noted, not a conflict: Daily Sabah dates the ceasefire to Oct 10, 2025; Al Jazeera to Oct 11, 2025 (announcement vs in-effect date). Daily Sabah rounds the cumulative toll as 'more than 74,500'; Al Jazeera gives the ministry's exact 74,618.
sections.what_disputed: No IDF/Israeli response to Thursday's strikes surfaced in the reporting checked; Israel's standing position (not in this article) is that it fires on threats and does not target civilians. Casualty attribution rests on Gaza Health Ministry figures and hospital medical sources, which the UN has treated as reliable. No independent verification of the individual strike attributions (drone vs artillery) exists.
sections.why_matters: The ceasefire toll passes 1,600 - and Thursday added four more, including a child killed in a tent. Hard counted number in the title; name the victim, show the Yellow Line push.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW UPDATE TO 1300-05 / 0700-01 (Al Jazeera published 2026-11-05T13:04:52Z = 17:04 ) -- Gaza: four Palestinians killed Thursday, including a child; ceasefire toll stands at 1,602 killed / 5,794 wounded since Oct 11, 2025

totw_analysis: Our read: The ceasefire toll passes 1,600 - and Thursday added four more, including a child killed in a tent. Hard counted number in the title; name the victim, show the Yellow Line push. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Is this still a ceasefire at all - 1,602 killed and 5,989 recorded violations into a truce that was supposed to end the killing, or is the toll the price of a truce Israel says Hamas keeps violating?
